# Theme variables

<!-- Generated by scripts/make-modkit.js from app/css/themes.css. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the only variables a theme's `vars` may set. Anything you leave out comes from the theme's `base`.
This table shows what each base uses, so you can see what you are changing.

| Variable | Used for | Ashen Crown (`ashen`) | Astral Oracle (`astral`) | Iron Litany (`iron`) | Blood Moon (`bloodmoon`) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | Page background | `#0b0908` | `#050816` | `#0a0a0b` | `#050407` |
| `--topbar` | Top bar background | `rgba(12,10,9,.9)` | `rgba(6,10,28,.9)` | `rgba(18,19,22,.94)` | `rgba(8,7,11,.9)` |
| `--fg` | Main text | `#e9dcc4` | `#dfe6f7` | `#e3d8bd` | `#dcd6e6` |
| `--muted` | Quieter text | `#a89a82` | `#9aa8c8` | `#a99e86` | `#a39cb4` |
| `--line` | Lines and borders | `#3b3022` | `#26345e` | `#3a2a10` | `#2c2836` |
| `--panel` | Boxes, menus and dialogs | `#15110f` | `#0a1030` | `#16171a` | `#0e0c13` |
| `--panel-fg` | Text in boxes | `#e9dcc4` | `#dfe6f7` | `#e3d8bd` | `#dcd6e6` |
| `--chip-bg` | The wheel's question: background | `#15110f` | `#0a1030` | `#16171a` | `#0e0c13` |
| `--chip-fg` | The wheel's question: text | `#ffd7a8` | `#eef6ff` | `#e8c46a` | `#f1ecf7` |
| `--chip-border` | The wheel's question: border | `#6b5636` | `#5a78c4` | `#8a5f1f` | `#c9cede55` |
| `--chip-radius` | The wheel's question: corner rounding | `3px` | `6px` | `0` | `2px` |
| `--accent` | Main highlight: primary buttons, links, active items | `#e0662d` | `#6f9cff` | `#b3201c` | `#c41e3a` |
| `--accent2` | Second highlight | `#e0b46a` | `#cfe3ff` | `#e8c46a` | `#9fd36a` |
| `--accent-fg` | Text on accent-coloured buttons | `#ffe9cf` | `#fff` | `#ffe9b0` | `#fff` |
| `--good` | Buffs and good news | `#9fd36a` | `#8fe0c4` | `#9fd36a` | `#9fd36a` |
| `--bad` | Debuffs and bad news | `#ff7a5c` | `#ff8fa3` | `#ff5c4d` | `#ff6b85` |
| `--btn-bg` | Normal button background | `#16120f` | `#0a1030` | `#1d1f23` | `#0e0c13` |
| `--btn-fg` | Normal button text | `#e9dcc4` | `#dfe6f7` | `#e3d8bd` | `#dcd6e6` |
| `--radius` | Corner rounding of boxes and buttons | `3px` | `6px` | `0` | `2px` |
| `--font` | Body text font | `"EB Garamond",Georgia,serif` | `"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif` | `"Share Tech Mono",Consolas,monospace` | `"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif` |
| `--font-display` | Heading font | `"Cinzel","Palatino Linotype",serif` | `"Cinzel","Palatino Linotype",serif` | `"Cinzel","Palatino Linotype",serif` | `"Cormorant SC","Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif` |
| `--font-chip` | The wheel's question font | `"Cinzel",serif` | `"Cormorant SC","Cormorant Garamond",serif` | `"Share Tech Mono",monospace` | `"Cormorant Garamond",serif` |
| `--font-result` | Font of the big result above the wheel | `"Cinzel",serif` | `"Cinzel",serif` | `"Cinzel",serif` | `"Cormorant SC",serif` |
| `--result-weight` | Boldness of the big result (400 normal to 900 heaviest) | `900` | `700` | `900` | `700` |

Values may be colours, sizes or font lists, up to 200 characters. They may not load anything: no `url()`,
`image-set()` or similar, and no `;`, `{`, `}`, `<`, `>`, `@` or backslashes.
